scope: All ten PNGs in the focused Europa enhanced-color run directly inspected: both DPRs, unlit scene/details, lit scene/details and lit drag. Static review only.

resolvedFinding.result: The source-backed targeted capture exposes actual enhanced-color observations, closing the earlier visual gap where only monochrome fallback was visible.

reviewedImages.note: The actual tan enhanced-color footprint is clearly visible near the globe center, with brown linear surface markings. Additional southern/right color patches and surrounding monochrome imagery remain distinct. The straight footprint edges are visible; large lineaments continue across the color/base boundary without an obvious gross displacement. The limited-color/fallback explanation and thumbnail are readable.

limits: Acceptance is restricted to the actual captured poses and displayed footprint. It does not assert whole-surface color coverage, all-pole/all-camera behavior, absolute colorimetry, or native-pixel parity.
The visible footprint edges, regional contrast differences and fine projection/band boundaries are retained; no seamless global-color claim.
Enabled scene shadows obscure much of this footprint; the unlit captures are the primary color-reading evidence.
DPR1 PNGs were viewed at1440x1000; DPR2 previews were displayed at1889x1312 from2880x2000.
The numerical source-registration, contributor-validity and scientific provenance claims are covered by separate source/tests evidence, not proved anew by these PNGs.
